items.t: Crank or cam sensor can make the engine stall (recall)
items.job: Replace crank and cam position sensors (recall)

items.t: Loss of power or stalling from a failing crank sensor
Seat side airbags may not deploy (recall)
Alternator can short and overheat (recall)
items.note: If the recall was done long ago and the alternator fails again now, YourMechanic averages about $415 for a Q45 alternator; 1997-2001 cars run higher.

items.t: Key comes out without the shifter in Park (recall)
17-inch alloy wheels can crack (recall)
Brake lights may not come on (recall)
Tail lamps don't meet brake light rules (recall)
Jerky shifts or slipping automatic transmission
items.note: Owner-reported: one Q45 owner was quoted $1,900 and paid about $2,350 for a rebuild; a factory remanufactured unit was quoted at about $1,600 before labor. A fluid service and diagnosis cost far less and should come first.

items.t: Check engine light from EVAP purge valve
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $390 for 1997-2001 cars and about $595-$615 for the 4.5L years.

items.t: Knock sensor fault causes surging or poor power
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $1,077-$1,277 total for 1997-2001 Q45s.

items.t: Cracked intake air duct causes rough running
items.job: Rough-running diagnosis and intake leak check
items.note: This is the inspection only; the cracked rubber duct is priced separately.

items.t: Cracked plastic engine cooling fan
items.note: An owner reported about $100 for a new fan.

items.t: Broken front coil spring
items.job: Replace front strut assembly with new spring
items.note: YourMechanic averages about $750 per strut assembly; replace in pairs. Have the tire checked if the spring end cut it.

items.t: Worn front struts knocking
items.note: YourMechanic averages about $750 per strut; its per-car Q45 examples run about $1,250-$2,050 for a pair.

items.t: Worn shocks or sport mode stops working
items.note: YourMechanic estimates about $1,120 for a rear pair and $1,660 for a front pair on 2002-2006 Q45s.

items.t: Headlight HID bulbs burn out
items.note: An owner reports about $130 per side in labor because body parts must come off. Name-brand bulbs cost more than generic ones.

items.t: Power seat motor burns out
items.note: Owner-reported: one 2004 owner was quoted about $987 because the motor is built into the seat frame.

items.t: Airbag warning light stays on
items.note: This is the diagnosis only. A side airbag fix under the recall is free at a dealer.

items.t: No crank from failing starter relays
items.note: Generic YourMechanic starter-relay estimate (not Q45-specific): about $150-$220 per relay. These cars have two relays.

items.t: Idler pulley seizes and belt snaps
items.job: Replace idler pulley and drive belt
items.note: YourMechanic averages about $126 for the pulley alone; add a new belt if it snapped.
